_doc: Rows of the mob export (tools/model/mobs.mjs, run by tools/build_mobs.sh): each builds <glb> and <clips> from a mobgen template. lod_divisor: the LOD voxel is the template's 0.5 m block over this, 0 keeps mobgen's full detail. Defaults apply to every row; a row may override any of them. A row narrows the template to its sprite: `brief` (what was read from the sprite, for the next person), `params` (the template's param ranges it overrides: a number, {min,max} or {choices}), `materials` (the palette sampled from the sprite: name -> {color, emissive}; a name here no longer follows the template's hue params) and `parts` (signature features: a shape on a bone at its head/tail/mid, metres from there, mirrored to the other side's bone; see PartSpec in tools/model/packages/mobgen/src/core/template.ts). A row may also set `attack_clip` (the shared-rig attack to play instead of its template's: an id of mobgen's attackClips.jsonnet, lunge-grab or swipe) `idle` (slack or aggravated), `budgets` (template budget entries it replaces, for a body reshaped past the template) and `budget_headroom` (a factor widening the template's voxel budgets at the top, for a row whose parts add many voxels). Judge a row with tools/mob_sheet.sh.

mobs.brief: Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/undead/ghoul.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a hunched, wide-stanced ghoul, broad shoulders, small dark head sunk between them, long arms hanging out and bent with huge splayed clawed hands (as big as the head), a thin torso with a torn open red Y on the chest, thick legs apart in a lurch. Palette (sampled): skin grey-green #5a6c5a / light #7a907a, shadow and legs near-black grey #383838, hands and chest dark red-brown #4a1818 / #783828, eyes yellow #ffff00 glowing in a dark face. Signature: glowing yellow eyes, big dark-red clawed hands, red torn chest. Motion: a lurching stagger with the arms out and ready to grab.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/hobgoblin_new.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a squat, broad red goblin in a fighting crouch, wide shoulders, big hands low and out to the sides (one reaching), short thick legs apart with clawed feet, a small head in a grey iron cap with a dark brim, a wide open snarling mouth. Palette (sampled): skin red #942416 / dark red #5c160d / bright #c5311d, grey straps and cap #483e3c / #705d55, black #1f1f1f, eyes yellow. Signature: the red skin, the grey cap, two dark straps crossed over the chest, the open snarl. Motion: a ready crouch, arms out, then a hacking swipe.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/gnoll_shaman.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a lean, bent gnoll, a narrow tall frame stooped forward, one long thin arm thrust out ahead pointing a hex, the other bent back, a small head with a long white-bearded muzzle and red glaring eyes, a short brown loincloth, long yellow digitigrade legs with big feet. Palette (sampled): fur tan #a08430 / light #c09e3a / shadow #604f1d, loincloth and strap brown #57322b / #3d241c, beard white, eyes red #e02020 glowing. Signature: the white beard muzzle, glowing red eyes, the pointing arm, the brown kilt. Motion: a stooped prowl with one arm pointing, a hexing jab.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/minotaur.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: an enormous body-builder torso, shoulders far wider than the hips, huge arms bulging and crossed up in front, the small red-brown bull head sunk low between the shoulders with grey horns curving out and up, a narrow waist over red-brown fur breeches and short legs ending in white hooves. Palette (sampled): flesh #e5a282 / light #ffb691 / shade #a5765e, head and breeches red-brown #a02800 / #802000 / #601800, horns and hooves grey-white #c0c0c0. Signature: the horns, the tiny head in huge shoulders, the vast arms. Motion: a heavy slow stalk with the head lowered, a goring swipe.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/undead/bog_body.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a stocky, headless-looking mass of a man, blocky shoulders and thick arms hanging at the sides, a short thick body and short legs, an irregular lumpy outline as if wrapped in moss. Palette (sampled): near-black green #0b1600 / #141800, mid moss #213b05, bright moss #3d5a14, peat brown #694e1b. Signature: the camouflage of moss and peat blotches over a dark body, and the lack of any face. Motion: a slow sodden trudge, a heavy two-armed grab.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/animals/ice_beast.png, side-on. Silhouette: a hulking, hunched four-legged frost beast, low and wide, huge shoulders and forelimbs with the head sunk low at the front, thick bent legs, a jagged white ice crest down the back. Palette (sampled): steel blue #3f6497 / #386287, mid ice #67a6c0, pale cyan highlights #a7ffff, white rime #f9f9fb, shadow teal #004d4d (lifted here for the layer's light). Signature: white ice crest and spikes along the spine, cyan claws, glowing eyes. Motion: a heavy prowling trot, a pounce with the jaws open.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/demons/ice_devil.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a lean muscular humanoid devil, wide square shoulders tapering to a narrow waist, long arms hanging with long clawed hands spread at the sides, straight legs, a small head with two big horns swept back and out like wings, two magenta eyes. Palette (sampled): ice white #ffffff / pale cyan #c0ffff / #a8e0e0 / grey-cyan shade #78a0a0, bright cyan speckles #00ffff over the body, magenta eyes #ff0080. Signature: the swept-back horns, the glowing magenta eyes, the cyan speckles, the long claws. Motion: an upright stalk, a clawed rake as it casts.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/nonliving/water_elemental_new.png, seen from the front. Silhouette: a squat, wide blob of a torso, rounded top with no distinct neck or head, short thick legs bowed out at the knees, long arms hanging at the sides ending in rounded fists. Palette (sampled): pale blue water #88b3f4 / #709bf7, mid blue #5877ae, dark blue-grey shade #334464 / #2d3f64, green weed strands #1a8a3a hanging across the chest and belt, a small brown patch #8a5a28 on the right belly. Signature: the dome-shaped water body, weed strands, brown patch. Motion: a heavy wobbling trudge, a sweeping two-armed splash.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/animals/giant_cockroach_new.png, three-quarter view. Silhouette: a giant cockroach, low and broad, a glossy oval brown carapace with a lighter tan sheen on top, a small dark head with red eyes in front, two very long thin orange feelers sweeping forward and up, six thin dark-brown legs splayed out to the sides. Palette (sampled): carapace amber #c88a20 / #b07818, shadow brown #5d3500 / #492703, sheen #e8b030, feelers orange #ffb835, head and legs near-black brown #2e0d00, eyes red. Signature: the long orange feelers and the glossy shell. Motion: a fast alternating-tripod scuttle, a quick rear-up and bite.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/animals/queen_ant_new.png, three-quarter view. Silhouette: a queen ant. A huge swollen glossy pink egg-sac abdomen low at the back, a narrow waist, a reddish-brown segmented thorax raised well above it, a head with two long bent feelers, six long thin rust-red legs splayed wide. Palette (sampled): abdomen pink #f0a090 over salmon #d45133, thorax and head red-brown #a43a21 / #74291a, outlines near-black red #470e03, legs and feelers rust #c64629. Signature: the enormous abdomen on a thin waist and the raised front body, unlike the skitter's flat oval. Motion: the insect plan's tripod scuttle, rear-up and bite. Built with the insect plan's ant params (thoraxLength, thoraxRaise, abdomenSize, abdomenDrop, waist, hindLegsOnThorax); the abdomen's pink is painted by the row's parts.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/nonliving/fire_elemental_new.png, front on. Silhouette: a small head with two dark eye slits on a torso of flame, two thin flame arms flung out and down, the body tapering into one long curling flame tail instead of legs, ragged flame tongues licking up from the head and shoulders. Palette (sampled): yellow-white core #fff08a, yellow #ffd21a, orange #ff9a10, red edges #e0300a. Signature: the long curling tail, the dark eye slits, the bright core. Motion: hovers; the tail sways in a travelling wave; a cast thrusts the arms forward. Glows: every material carries emission (vertex alpha) so it reads as a light source.

Sprite assets/third_party/dungeon-crawl-32x32/monster/nonliving/orb_of_electricity.png. Silhouette: a roughly spherical crackling orb with ragged edges, no limbs. Palette (sampled): bright pink-white core #ffd8ff, hot pink #f060ff, violet #9a40f0, dark purple edges #5a20d0. Signature: the brighter core and the jagged spikes of lightning all round. Motion: hovers; the spikes jitter; a cast flares and lunges. Glows: every material carries emission (vertex alpha) so it reads as a light source.
